We've built the **Opportunity Designed** Design System from scratch. The project started with a solo strategy consultancy's brand — a parchment/obsidian/violet palette, Anton display type, and a terse "operator" voice — plus 50+ uploaded assets (marks, icons, headshots, templates, website HTML, brand playbook).

**Work completed:**

- Explored all provided materials: website HTML, brand playbook docx, mark/icon assets, internal templates.
- Wrote `readme.md` with full CONTENT FUNDAMENTALS (terse, imperative, I/you mix, no emoji), VISUAL FOUNDATIONS (drafting-sheet aesthetic, corner ticks, parchment grain, technical line-weight, no animations), ICONOGRAPHY (typographic: numerals and Unicode arrows), and sources.
- Built token CSS: `colors.css` (parchment, obsidian, violet + semantic aliases), `typography.css` (Anton 700, Inter 300–700), `fonts.css` (@font-face for both + Google Fonts fallback for Anton), `layout.css` (8px baseline, tick spacing). Root `styles.css` as import manifest only.
- Authored 16 reusable components (Button, ButtonText, Eyebrow, SectionHead, Plate, FigCaption, Tag, TitleBlock, Field, GrainOverlay, plus 6 website screens as composables). Each has `.jsx`, `.d.ts` (props contract), and `.prompt.md`.
- Created 20 foundation specimen cards across Colors, Type, Spacing, Brand sections; all render live.
- Built website UI kit (Home, About, Opportunity Review, Contact screens) with click-through nav and form.
- Authored 5 branded slide types (Title, Content, Quote, Comparison, Closing) + a reusable Proposal template in `templates/proposal/`.
- Wrote `SKILL.md` for downstream Agent use.

**Current state:** All components compiled, all cards registered, bundle ready. Website UI kit fully interactive; slides + proposal template tested and rendering.

**Open issues / asks:**

1. **Site CSS missing** — you provided HTML but not the compiled `css/` or `js/site.js`. UI kit spacing/timings are reconstructed, not byte-exact. If you can drop the real CSS, I'll tighten fidelity.
2. **Iconography** — flagged Lucide as optional fallback; confirm if you want a specific icon set instead.
3. **Color palette** — playbook mentions desert ochre/rust tones; the built site uses violet/parchment. Want to explore the earthier version, or stay as-is?

**Files:** `styles.css` (root), `tokens/colors.css`, `tokens/typography.css`, `tokens/fonts.css`, `tokens/layout.css`, `components/` (16 jsx+dts+prompt), `foundation_cards/` (20 html), `ui_kits/website/`, `templates/proposal/`, `assets/` (marks, headshots), `readme.md`, `SKILL.md`.

**Next:** Which surface (website fidelity, slides, templates) is the priority to perfect? I'll iterate hard on that one.

contentBlocks.text:
Redesign complete. Summary of the direction shift:

- **Dark by default for all digital** — the entire website UI kit (nav, home, about, opportunity review, contact) is now on obsidian with parchment/dusk text and light hairlines. Documents/contracts stay parchment.
- **Sharp corners** — buttons, CTAs, and status chips are now square (0 radius), systemically via the Button/Tag components; slide tags too.
- **B&W photography** — full-grayscale mountain hero, a full-bleed tower band, and a B&W headshot anchor Home and About; the closing CTA sits on a darkened B&W tower shot.
- **Less crowded** — cut the busiest sections (the 3-column "who" plate, the 6-cell career grid, the duplicated ways-to-work rail), widened gaps, and gave each section more air.
- Kept the color scheme (parchment/obsidian/violet-light accent) and updated the readme's Radii + direction notes.

One note: I couldn't visually confirm this turn's build in my own preview — it was still serving the prior compiled bundle — so the background verifier is checking against the fresh compile. If it flags any dark-on-dark contrast or layout issues, I'll fix them.
